| 7 | Moses | H4872 [content]: stepGloss: Moses — A man from the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.2.10;; referred to as Moses or "his" (KJV= Moses) (מֹשֶׁה), or Moses (Aramiac מֹשֶׁה), or Moses (=LXX, KJV= Manasseh) (מְנַשֶּׁה), or Moses (Μωϋσῆς, Μωσῆς);; son of Amram and Jochebed ;; a brother of Aaron and Miriam ;; husband of Zipporah ;; father of Gershom and Eliezer . § the prophet and lawgiver, leader of the exodus |

| 10 | Israel | H3478 [content]: stepGloss: Israel — A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.25.26;; referred to as Israel or [ ] or Israelite or "God" (KJV= Israel) (יִשְׂרָאֵל), or Israel (Aramiac יִשְׂרָאֵל), or Jacob or "he" (KJV= Jacob) (יַעֲקֹב), or Jeshurun (יְשֻׁרוּן), or Israelite (יִשְׂרְאֵלִי), or Israelitess (יִשְׂרְאֵלִית), or Israel or Israelite (Ἰσραήλ), or Jacob (Ἰακώβ), or Israelite or Israel (Ἰσραηλίτης);; son of Isaac and Rebekah ;; a brother of Esau ;; husband of Rachel , Leah , Zilpah and Bilhah ;; father of Reuben , Simeon , Levi , Judah , Dan , Naphtali , Gad , Asher , Issachar , Zebulun , Dinah , Joseph and Benjamin . |

| 15 | Jordan | H3383 [content]: stepGloss: Jordan — A location first mentioned at Gen.13.10;; referred to as Jordan (יַרְדֵּן), or Jordan (Ἰορδάνης). § the river of Palestine running from the roots of Anti-Lebanon to the Dead Sea a distance of approx 200 miles (320 km) |
| 16 | Jericho | H3405G [content]: stepGloss: Jericho — A location first mentioned at Num.22.1;; referred to as Jericho (יְרִיחוֹ), or Jericho (עִיר הַתְּמָרִים), or Jericho (עִיר הַתְּמָרִים), or Jericho (Ἱεριχώ). § a city 5 miles (8 km) west of the Jordan and 7 miles (11.5 km) north of the Dead Sea and the first city conquered by the Israelites upon entering the promised land of Canaan |
